messages:
maria: Heads-up — I'm starting a config-only deploy in the evening change window to tweak routing weights + tiny-batch window for noisy tenants. Target window 21:00-23:00 UTC. Plan: 2% canary 15m -> 20% ramp for 30m -> full. Will pin fallback model variant and keep old routing policy as immediate fallback. Deploy-bot: queued for 2026-03-22T21:00:00Z.
ajay: Thanks — can you paste the exact deploy command/config so SRE can run preflight checks? :eyes:
maria: sure, config snippet:```yaml
canary: 0.02
canary_duration: 15m
ramp_to: 0.20
ramp_duration: 30m
batch_window_ms: 12
request_timeout_ms: 850
route_policy: tenant_weight_adjustment
fallback_policy: pin_previous_variant
```
kevin: quick Q — are we changing request_timeout? 850ms is lower than current 1s, could increase tail OOM risk on large seqs.
maria: yeah lowering to 850 to trim p99 for short chats; we'll scope to tenants with median seq <= 512. Not changing model memory settings.
sre-ops: we'll run loadcheck on the canary cluster. Please confirm the tenant list and include one high-noise tenant to stress kv cache.
lina: adding the tenant list now. Also recommend TTL bump on cache to 30s for canary to reduce regen churn.
maria: good call — will set kv_cache_ttl: 30s for canary only.
ajay: rollback plan? If p99 latency jumps > 300ms or error rate > 0.5% we rollback to previous routing config and revert batch_window_ms.
sre-ops: ack. We'll attach a smoke test: 200 requests/s mixed prompt lengths for 10m during canary.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by maria at 1776543211. Next action: preflight checks (observability + smoke). Status: pending.
maria: preflight checklist: 1) dashboards linked, 2) tenants CSV committed, 3) rollback script ready, 4) owner oncall paged.
kevin: add model pin command to checklist:`deploybot pin-model --variant id=redwood-v2-stable --route previous`
maria: done.
sre-ops: we noticed that the batching change (12ms) could increase token packing; make sure batch size cap remains at 64 to avoid GPU mem bloat.
lina: will include cap: 64 in config.
ajay: one more — coordinate with Dedicated team for any scheduled maintenance overlap.
maria: checked — no overlap.
deploy-bot: preflight complete: observability OK, smoke tests: passed (latency delta +18ms, errors 0.12%). Proceeding to schedule canary at 21:00 UTC.
maria: starting canary now (2% traffic) — monitoring closely.
sre-ops: smoke running, watching p50/p90/p99, OOMs, and 5XXs.
lina: logs show a small bump in p90 for long prompts, but within threshold.
kevin: seeing one node with elevated mem pressure — ops to isolate and re-route if needed.
sre-ops: we rerouted that node out of canary, no user impact.
maria: ramping to 20% now per plan.
ajay: Observability shows stable, p99 still under threshold. :thumbsup:
kevin: good to keep a 10m hold after ramp to verify KV cache steady state.
sre-ops: holding.
maria: hold complete. No regressions. Rolling to full.
deploy-bot: rollout complete. Config applied to 100% at 1776543888.
ajay: great work — capture this in release notes (config-only: routing weights, tiny-batch 12ms, batch_cap 64, timeout 850ms, kv_cache_ttl 30s, fallback pinned).
maria: adding notes and closing thread. Thanks all. :tada:
